fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Client ID for a seller-owned Walmart Marketplace application: https://developer.walmart.com/

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The Client Secret paired with the seller application Client ID.

actions.name: get_inventory
actions.description: Get the current Walmart Marketplace inventory for one seller SKU.

shipNode.description: The fulfillment-center ID; omit it to use the default ship node.

inputSchema.description: The seller SKU and optional fulfillment center to inspect.

outputSchema.description: Inventory state returned by Walmart Marketplace.

actions.name: get_item
actions.description: Get one Walmart Marketplace seller item by product identifier.

productId.description: The SKU, item ID, GTIN, UPC, EAN, or ISBN to retrieve.

inputSchema.description: The Walmart Marketplace item identifier and identifier type.

item.description: The item returned by Walmart Marketplace.

actions.name: get_order
actions.description: Get one Walmart Marketplace purchase order by purchase order ID.

inputSchema.description: The Walmart Marketplace purchase order to retrieve.

order.description: The purchase order returned by Walmart Marketplace.

actions.name: list_items
actions.description: List items in the connected Walmart Marketplace seller catalog.

nextCursor.description: The cursor returned by a previous list-items response.

offset.description: The zero-based result offset, up to 10000.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return, from 1 through 1000.

gtin.description: A 14-digit Global Trade Item Number to match.

lifecycleStatus.description: The item lifecycle status to match.

publishedStatus.description: The item publication status to match.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for Walmart Marketplace seller items.

items.description: The seller items on this page.

anyOf.description: The total matching item count when Walmart provides it.

totalItems.description: The total matching item count when Walmart provides it.

anyOf.description: The cursor to send for the next page.

nextCursor.description: The cursor to send for the next page.

outputSchema.description: A page of Walmart Marketplace seller items.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: List recent Walmart Marketplace purchase orders with optional filters.

createdStartDate.description: Return orders created on or after this UTC or ISO-8601 date.

createdEndDate.description: Return orders created on or before this UTC or ISO-8601 date.

lastModifiedStartDate.description: Return orders modified on or after this UTC or ISO-8601 date.

lastModifiedEndDate.description: Return orders modified on or before this UTC or ISO-8601 date.

status.description: The purchase-order line status to match.

customerOrderId.description: A Walmart customer order ID to match.

purchaseOrderId.description: A Walmart purchase order ID to match.

limit.description: The maximum number of orders to return, from 1 through 200.

nextCursor.description: The complete query string returned as nextCursor in Walmart order metadata, beginning with ?. Provide it without other inputs.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for Walmart Marketplace purchase orders.

orders.description: The purchase orders on this page.

outputSchema.description: A page of Walmart Marketplace purchase orders.

actions.name: update_inventory
actions.description: Replace the Walmart Marketplace inventory amount for one seller SKU.

amount.description: The replacement number of units available to sell.

shipNode.description: The fulfillment-center ID; omit it to use the default ship node.

inputSchema.description: The seller SKU, replacement amount, and optional fulfillment center.

outputSchema.description: Inventory state returned by Walmart Marketplace.
